run_merge_candidates: run the merge_candidates script to concatenate all .t7 chunk files into a single all.t7 tensor file
run_merge_candidates_with_custom_chunk_s: run the merge_candidates script with a custom chunk size to merge .t7 files from a specified directory
run_merge_candidates_list_chunks: run the merge_candidates script to load and list all .t7 chunk files in the saved chunks directory
run_merge_candidates_concatenate_tensors: run the merge_candidates script to concatenate PyTorch tensor chunks along dimension 0 into one file
run_merge_candidates_skip_empty: run the merge_candidates script to merge .t7 chunks while skipping missing or empty chunk files
